purpose: Compare Facet and Lavish on equal-content review workflows without conflating final representation size with total Codex usage.

cases.title: Personal expense tracker storage decision
cases.prompt: Create a local interactive review comparing local-only storage and cloud synchronization for a personal expense tracker. Include decision context, an at-a-glance comparison, benefits, risks and mitigations, a reasoned recommendation, and exactly two decision choices. Assume one primary user, sensitive financial data, possible phone-and-laptop use, and reliable recovery. Do not browse, publish, or implement the tracker. Open the review and keep it running for feedback.
cases.revisionPrompt: Seamless phone-and-laptop access is now mandatory at launch. Update only what this changes, preserve useful content and feedback, and keep the review running.

cases.title: API migration readiness review
cases.prompt: Create a local interactive review for migrating a TypeScript client from a deprecated REST endpoint to a versioned replacement. Include executive summary, before-and-after request examples, breaking changes, compatibility risks, rollout checklist, rollback approach, and exactly two readiness choices. Do not change code or publish anything. Open the review and keep it running for feedback.
cases.revisionPrompt: A legacy mobile client cannot send the new required header for six weeks. Revise the rollout recommendation and affected risks only, preserving comments and decision history.

cases.title: Production incident retrospective
cases.prompt: Create a local interactive review of a fictional 47-minute checkout outage caused by an expired service credential and incomplete alert routing. Include impact, timeline, contributing factors, root cause, evidence, corrective actions, owners, and exactly two closure choices. Do not contact anyone or change systems. Open the review and keep it running for feedback.
cases.revisionPrompt: New evidence shows the credential warning fired but was routed to an unowned channel. Update the root cause and corrective actions without rewriting unaffected sections.

cases.title: Analytics vendor selection
cases.prompt: Create a local interactive review comparing three fictional analytics vendors for a privacy-conscious SaaS product. Include weighted criteria, cost assumptions, security and compliance risks, implementation effort, recommendation, dissenting considerations, and exactly two approval choices. Do not browse, purchase, or contact vendors. Open the review and keep it running for feedback.
cases.revisionPrompt: The recommended vendor increases its annual price by 35 percent. Recalculate the recommendation and update only affected evidence, risks, and decision rationale.

cases.title: AI assistant product roadmap
cases.prompt: Create a local interactive review for a six-month roadmap for a privacy-first AI assistant. Include goals, phases, dependencies, risks, success metrics, explicit non-goals, and exactly two scope choices. Do not implement or publish anything. Open the review and keep it running for feedback.
cases.revisionPrompt: Move offline support from the final phase into the launch milestone. Update dependencies, risks, and sequencing while preserving existing feedback.
